hero.title: Find your next best learning pathway
hero.text: Tell us where you are and where you want to go. Our AI drafts a personalised sequence of C2B programmes, and C2B experts review every recommendation before you see it.
hero.imageAlt: A group of young professionals learning together around a laptop

about.title: Campus2Business: from campus to business
about.text: C2B is an expert training centre that connects learning with real work. We help students start their careers with confidence, and help organizations through digital and cultural transformation by upskilling and reskilling their people.
about.imageAlt: A C2B expert in a one-to-one mentoring conversation

experts.title: Expert-led programmes
experts.text: Practical courses designed and taught by professionals from industry.

ai.title: AI with a human in the loop
ai.text: AI drafts each pathway; a C2B expert edits and approves it.

history.title: Built on real learning history
history.text: Recommendations learn from what similar learners completed next.

bilingual.title: Bilingual by design
bilingual.text: Every pathway and programme is available in English and Spanish.

how.title: Three steps to your learning pathway
how.text: The same simple journey for students and for employees invited by their organization.

profile.title: Build your profile
profile.text: Share your education, experience, skills, goals and learning preferences, and upload your CV.

design.title: AI and C2B experts design your pathway
design.text: Our AI proposes the best sequence of programmes and explains why. A C2B expert reviews it before it's published.

grow.title: Learn and grow
grow.text: Enroll in your next programme, track your progress and get an updated pathway as you complete courses.

students.title: Start your career with a clear plan
students.text: Not sure which course to take first? Get a step-by-step pathway built around your studies and your career goals.

match.title: Programmes that match your goals
match.text: From your first internship to your dream role.

order.title: A clear order
order.text: From foundation to advanced, with prerequisites taken care of.

why.title: Know why
why.text: Every recommendation explains how it helps you.

track.title: Track your progress
track.text: Follow your courses and rate them when you finish.

students.imageAlt: University students studying together on campus

orgs.title: Upskill and reskill your teams
orgs.text: Register your company, invite your employees and let C2B design the right training for each person, aligned with your goals and skill gaps.

invite.title: Invite employees in one click
invite.text: Share a secure invite link per department, with optional seat limits and expiry dates.

remarks.title: Your priorities, in every pathway
remarks.text: Add remarks on employees; C2B and the AI take them into account.

enroll.title: Enroll and pay by invoice
enroll.text: Enroll employees yourself and pay with an employer invoice.

reports.title: See progress and skill gaps
reports.text: Follow completion and skill gaps by department.

orgs.note: C2B reviews every organization before it can invite employees.
orgs.imageAlt: A corporate training session in a meeting room

programmes.title: Featured programmes
programmes.text: Explore the C2B catalogue across digital transformation, data, cloud, leadership and more.
